overallStatus.text: 🟡 AT RISK — 88–93% FKP adoption projected across Commercial, Gia2h, and Blackjack-J. Blackjack-A remains significantly below the 90% FY27 target.

executiveSummary.bottomLine: Blackjack-A migration projections are 20% below the FY27 90% target, driven by org timeline shifts and lengthy cluster-build timelines blocking STP and Security. Confirmed migrations shifting into FY28 (CDP, MonCloud BJ-A, ADX, Thunderbird) have capped maximum achievable FY27 adoption. Two critical timeline gaps remain.
keyChanges: Commercial and Gia2h Q4 projections increased about 0.5%, while Blackjack-A and Blackjack-J fell 1.3% and 0.3%, respectively.
ADX timeline shifts moved SFCD Managed Workflows, SFCD Ross, SFCD Structured Config, and Spinnaker work from R266 to R268.
Einstein Analytics moved from On Track to At Risk; clarity is expected in 8b, and Flowsnake is consequently also At Risk.

rebaseline.description: After discussion and alignment with FKP leadership, the program will re-baseline status reporting against the HPS M6.2.1 90% FKP service instance target. This new target will appropriately reflect FY28 timelines and track against maximum feasible progress.
